```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

Here is some information on variables, dataset size, and mean flipper length:

```{r}
glimpse(penguins)

penguins|>
  drop_na(flipper_length_mm) |>
  summarise(mean(flipper_length_mm))
```
